query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

parts.text:
**Title: The 2016 Presidential Rap Battle**
**Setting:** A dimly lit stage with two podiums. In the center stands **Lester Holt**, wearing a sleek suit and holding a microphone. The crowd is buzzing. Behind Hillary Clinton is a blue-lit screen showing the Constitution; behind Donald Trump is a gold-lit screen showing the Trump Tower logo.

---

### **[INTRO]**

**LESTER HOLT:**
(Stepping to the center, beatboxing a light intro)
Welcome to the main event, the clash of the titans,
Where the rhetoric is heavy and the tension is heightening!
No more policy papers, no more soft-spoken chats,
Tonight we settle the score with some heavy-hitting tracks!
In the blue corner, representing the state,
The former First Lady, she’s here to debate:
**HILLARY CLINTON!**

*(The crowd cheers. Hillary steps up to her podium, gives a practiced, wave-and-smile, and adjusts her pantsuit.)*

**LESTER HOLT:**
And in the red corner, the billionaire boss,
He’s here to make deals and he don't take a loss.
The mogul of Manhattan, the king of the screen:
**DONALD TRUMP!**

*(The crowd roars. Trump steps up, puckers his lips, gives a thumbs-up, and points aggressively at the audience.)*

**LESTER HOLT:**
Two rounds. No interruptions. Let’s keep it clean. 
Hillary, you won the coin toss. Drop the mic on the scene!

---

### **[ROUND 1: HILLARY CLINTON]**

*(The beat drops: a classic, boom-bap, heavy 90s East Coast hip-hop beat.)*

**HILLARY:**
*(Adjusting her mic, leaning in with a sharp smile)*
Let’s get real, Donald, you are out of your depth,
While I worked in the Situation Room, you held your breath.
I’ve got forty years of public service right on my shelf,
While you spent forty years just serving yourself!
You’re a paper-thin tycoon, a fragile glass cup,
When the facts get too hot, you just scream out:

**TRUMP:** *(Leaning into his mic)*
*WRONG!*

**HILLARY:**
See? He can’t help but interrupt.
You talk about a wall that you’ll never even build,
While your cabinet of cronies is getting pre-filled.
I’m breaking glass ceilings, the first in the race,
While you’re spray-tanned and yelling, a national disgrace.
You praise Vladimir Putin, you tweet in the night,
A man with your temperament shouldn’t have the red light.
I’ve got the stamina, the plans, and the preparation,
To lead, to unite, and to build up this nation!

---

### **[ROUND 1: DONALD TRUMP]**

*(The beat shifts: a heavy, trap-style brass beat with a booming bass.)*

**TRUMP:**
*(Shaking his head, waving his hands in a accordion motion)*
Excuse me, Lester, but that was a disaster.
A total low-energy, slow-motion pastor!
You’ve been in Washington for thirty years, Hill,
And what did you do? Absolutely nil!
You’re the face of the swamp, the elite, the political class,
But the American people are raising their glass
To a winner, a builder, a self-made icon,
While you delete emails and leave the servers turned on!
Thirty-three thousand! Poof! In the trash!
Just like your campaign, about to go crash.
Your husband signed NAFTA, a terrible deal,
It gutted the Rust Belt—the damage is real!
I’m gonna build a wall, and it’s gonna be *yuge*,
While you and Bill run a Clinton Foundation refuge.
The country is losing, we’re not winning no more,
But I’m stepping up to settle the score!

---

### **[ROUND 2: HILLARY CLINTON]**

*(The beat changes to a fast-paced, dramatic orchestral hip-hop track.)*

**HILLARY:**
*(Smirking, shaking her head)*
"Self-made"? Please, Donald, let’s look at the source:
A million-dollar loan from your father, of course!
You brag about your wealth, but your taxes are missing,
Are you hiding your debts while the Kremlin you're kissing?
You’re a con man, a fraud, a casino bankruptor,
Of American values, the ultimate corruptor.
You insult our allies, you mock the disabled,
Your entire campaign is a toxic, dark fable.
I stood for eleven hours straight in Congress to fight,
While you were hosting *Celebrity Apprentice* at night.
So go back to your tower, your golf, and your brand,
Because a bully like you will never rule this land!

---

### **[ROUND 2: DONALD TRUMP]**

*(The beat gets darker, with a heavy, marching snare drum.)*

**TRUMP:**
*(Leaning forward, pointing his finger)*
Eleven hours of talking, and what did you say?
Nothing! You let our heroes slide away!
You call my supporters "deplorable," how sweet,
That’s why you’re losing the working-class street!
You’ve got no stamina, Hillary, you’re ready to fold,
You’re bought by Wall Street, you do what you’re told.
I pay zero taxes? That just makes me smart!
I use the tax code like a master of art.
You want four more years of the same old regime?
A nightmare disguised as a progressive dream?
I’m bringing back factories, bringing back pride,
No more letting globalists take us for a ride!
So go back to your couch, go back to your emails,
My movement is moving, and yours is in details.
America’s back, we’re breaking the chain,
And yes, believe me—we're making it great again!

---

### **[OUTRO]**

**LESTER HOLT:**
*(Stepping back into the center as the beat fades out, holding his hands up to quiet the crowd)*
Time is up! The mics have been dropped!
The beat has finished, the rhythm has stopped!
A battle of policy, ego, and pride,
Now it’s up to the voters to decide!

Who won? Who’s next? 
America... you cast your vote!
